promptingStudio.sampleSpeechBlock: Rivers wider than cities pour north toward the Arctic, and the horizon never quite arrives. Somewhere far below, chimney smoke rises from a village perfectly straight into the freezing air. This is Siberia. promptingStudio.combinedPromptTemplate:
Scene: An insulated winter log-cabin audio setup. Ultra-quiet background, rich close-mic warmth conveying the frost-bitten chill and resilient human warmth of Siberia.
Sample Context: Reflective, grounded, empathetic, and compelling. Steady cadence that respects the vast, quiet solitude of northern taiga settlements.

Speaker 1 - Northern Chronicler (Adam / Liam):
Rivers wider than cities pour north toward the Arctic, and the horizon never quite arrives. Somewhere far below, chimney smoke rises from a village perfectly straight into the freezing air. This is Siberia. It stretches from the Eural Mountains all the way to the Pacific, larger than the United States and all of Europe put together. And for most of the world, its name means exactly one thing. Cold.
